title: Mama Bloom's Brood
identity_notes: Serialized Jewish-American domestic comedy centered on Becky and Jake Bloom, daughters Yetta and Sarah, and sons-in-law Harold and Sidney. The surviving story moves from family weddings and retirement plans into a cross-country automobile trip and an extended Hollywood/movie-business arc. Exact broadcast dates and original station schedule remain unresolved.
